name: @lucagiftzek/dsh-orchestrator
description: Agent swarm and task orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: an Orchestrate sidebar tab and orch_* tools to spawn, prompt and fork agent chats, run command, scrape, http and agent tasks on local, ssh or remote runners, provider status cards, and a secret-protected machine API.

scripts.check: for f in lib/core.js lib/security.js lib/store.js lib/runners.js lib/agents.js lib/tasks.js lib/providers.js lib/tools.js lib/lossless.js lib/api.js lib/dual-settings.js lib/index.js scripts/build.mjs test/run.mjs test/lossless.mjs test/client.mjs test/dual.mjs; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && echo 'all files OK'
scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node test/lossless.mjs && node test/client.mjs && node test/dual.mjs
